title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Peripheral Arterial Occlusive Disease
intro: Herbal essential oils for Peripheral arterial occlusive disease are a natural and alternative approach to managing this condition, which is characterized by the narrowing or blockage of blood vessels in the limbs, leading to pain, numbness, and limited mobility. These oils are derived from plants and have been used for centuries to promote blood circulation, reduce inflammation, and improve overall vascular health. Some examples of herbal essential oils that have been found to be beneficial in treating peripheral arterial occlusive disease include Helichrysum, which has anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce swelling and pain; Ginger, which can help improve circulation and reduce inflammation; Rosemary, which has antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage; Lavender, which can help relax and reduce stress, promoting overall circulation and well-being; Frankincense, which has anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce pain and inflammation; and Thyme, which has antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage and promote blood circulation. By incorporating these herbal essential oils into their treatment regimen, individuals with peripheral arterial occlusive disease may experience improved circulation, reduced pain, and enhanced overall quality of life.

preparations.preparation_desc: Ginkgo biloba essential oils have been used to treat peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD) due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. These properties help to improve blood flow, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit platelet aggregation, which are beneficial in treating PAOD. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba, including flavonoids, bilobalide, and ginkgolides, contribute to its therapeutic effects by increasing nitric oxide production, reducing inflammation, and improving vascular function. Regular use of Ginkgo biloba essential oils has been reported to improve symptoms of PAOD, such as pain and fatigue, and enhance overall quality of life.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Zhongguo yao li xue bao = Acta pharmacologica Sinica", Ginkgo biloba essential oils for peripheral arterial occlusive disease were found to decrease erythrocyte stiffness and relaxation time, blood plasma viscosity, and plasma fibrinogen concentration, while improving the pain-free walking distance of patients with this condition after 48 weeks of treatment.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa essential oils have been found to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties, which help to improve blood flow and reduce inflammation in the affected areas, making it a potential treatment for peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD). The bioactive constituents of Curcuma longa, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, have been shown to inhibit platelet aggregation and reduce oxidative stress, thereby helping to prevent the progression of PAOD. By reducing inflammation and improving blood flow, Curcuma longa essential oils can help to alleviate symptoms of PAOD, such as pain and weakness in the legs, and improve overall quality of life. The benefits of using Curcuma longa essential oils to treat PAOD include reduced risk of amputation, improved mobility, and enhanced overall cardiovascular health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Curcuma longa essential oils may have potential effects on IL-1β suppression, which could be beneficial in treating peripheral arterial occlusive disease by attenuating inflammation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils, derived from the leaves of the rosemary plant, have been studied for their potential in treating peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD) due to their vasodilatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents, including carnosic acid, ursolic acid, and camphor, contribute to the oil's ability to improve blood circulation and reduce inflammation in the affected areas. By increasing nitric oxide production, these compounds help to relax blood vessels and improve oxygen delivery to tissues, thereby alleviating symptoms of PAOD such as pain and fatigue. The benefits of using Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils for PAOD treatment include improved blood flow, reduced oxidative stress, and enhanced overall cardiovascular health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Acta pharmaceutica (Zagreb, Croatia)", Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils do not specifically address peripheral arterial occlusive disease, however, the study mentions that Rosmarinus officinalis is a plant species rich in polyphenols, particularly flavonoids, which are of interest in the prevention of thrombus formation, including in cardiovascular diseases such as peripheral arterial occlusive disease, by exhibiting antiaggregatory effects.

preparations.preparation_desc: Zingiber officinale essential oils, derived from the rhizomes of the ginger plant, have been traditionally used to treat peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD) due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale essential oils, including gingerols and shogaols, help to improve blood circulation by relaxing blood vessels and reducing inflammation in the affected areas. By reducing inflammation and promoting blood flow, Zingiber officinale essential oils can help alleviate symptoms of PAOD, such as pain and cramping in the legs, and improve overall cardiovascular health. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale essential oils to treat PAOD include reduced risk of complications, improved quality of life, and a natural alternative to conventional medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "BioFactors (Oxford, England)", Zingiber officinale essential oils may have therapeutic potential for peripheral arterial occlusive disease due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, including the inhibition of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB) signaling pathways and the suppression of oxidative molecules.

preparations.preparation_desc: Panax ginseng essential oils have been studied for their potential to treat peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD), a condition characterized by reduced blood flow to the extremities. The anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties of Panax ginseng essential oils may help to improve blood circulation and reduce the severity of PAOD symptoms. The bioactive constituents, including ginsenosides, ginsenides, and saponins, in Panax ginseng essential oils have been found to promote angiogenesis, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit platelet aggregation, contributing to the alleviation of PAOD symptoms. Overall, the benefits of using Panax ginseng essential oils to treat PAOD include improved circulation, reduced pain and discomfort, and enhanced overall quality of life.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Panax ginseng essential oils, specifically the active ingredient Ginsenoside Rg1 (GS-Rg1), have been shown to inhibit vascular intimal hyperplasia in peripheral arterial occlusive disease by reducing the expressions of the SDF-1α/CXCR4, SCF/c-kit and FKN/CX3CR1 axes.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, also known as English lavender oil, have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including peripheral arterial occlusive disease (PAOD). The bioactive constituents of Salvia miltiorrhiza, including tanshinones and phenolic acids, have been shown to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce inflammation, and improve endothelial function, making it a promising natural remedy for PAOD. The benefits of using Salvia miltiorrhiza essential oils to treat PAOD include improved circulation, reduced symptoms of pain and fatigue, and enhanced quality of life for individuals affected by this condition.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology", Piper nigrum essential oils were not specifically investigated for peripheral arterial occlusive disease in the provided study, however, piperine, a major compound in Piper nigrum, was shown to have vasculoprotective effect and increase acetylcholine-induced vasorelaxation of isolated thoracic aorta, suggesting potential benefits for cardiovascular health.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica", Angelica sinensis essential oils may have the potential to ameliorate peripheral arterial occlusive disease due to its depressant effect on blood pressure and ability to improve cardiac ischemia.

intro_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", essential oils from Rosa damascena, specifically the compound 2-phenyl ethyl alcohol (PEA) isolated from the spent flowers, have shown potential in treating peripheral arterial occlusive disease due to its vasorelaxation properties, particularly in conduit and resistance blood vessels.
